name: io.github.hynko431/coldpin
title: Coldpin
description: Zero-execution npx/npm security auditor: static taint, Git parity, clean anchors, batch triage.

environmentVariables.name: COLDPIN_OFFLINE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to force offline fail-closed mode

environmentVariables.name: COLDPIN_PRIVATE_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated internal @scope list routed strictly to private registry

environmentVariables.name: COLDPIN_PRIVATE_REGISTRY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTPS private npm registry URL for COLDPIN_PRIVATE_SCOPES

environmentVariables.name: COLDPIN_REGISTRY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional read-only bearer token sent strictly over HTTPS to COLDPIN_PRIVATE_REGISTRY_URL
